title.zh: Antigravity 把 /btw 做成可提升的支线
title.en: Antigravity turns /btw into a side quest that can be promoted

summary.zh: Antigravity 官方演示了新版 /btw。旧用法是在主 Agent 忙时插问一句；新用法可以从当前任务分出一条支线，沿着支线继续探索，值得保留的方向再提升出来。主线继续留在原位，试错过程不用挤进正在执行的会话。这是官方产品演示，日报没有写明分支继承了哪些上下文、提升后带走哪些结论。
summary.en: Antigravity officially demonstrated a new /btw. The old use was a quick question while the main agent was busy. The new use can split a side quest from the current task, keep exploring along that branch, and promote a direction worth keeping. The main thread stays in place, so exploration does not have to crowd the running session. This is an official product demo; the digest did not specify which context a branch inherits or which conclusions are carried back after a promotion.

brief.zh: Antigravity 新版 /btw 可从当前任务分出支线继续探索，值得保留的方向再提升出来，主线仍留在原位。
brief.en: Antigravity's new /btw can split a side quest from the current task, keep exploring it, and promote a useful direction, while the main thread stays in place.

why.zh: 这是比多开一个聊天窗更具体的工作流：主线继续跑，支线去试替代方案，只在用户决定时合流。
why.en: This is more specific than opening another chat: the main line keeps running, a side line tries an alternative, and they join only when the user decides.
